fields.hero_prompt: Build pre training survey questions that my 38 dispatchers answer a week before software training, scored as a baseline.

faq_plan.q: What are pre training survey questions?
How do I create pre training survey questions?

plan.angle: The top 10 for pre training survey questions are question lists and templates (TalentLMS, SmartSurvey, RapidoForm, HeySurvey, Pointerpro) that stop at the wording, and half of them are about post-training feedback. This page stays before the session: it shows four pre training surveys built from a prompt that set a baseline score, place learners into the right session, shape the agenda from what learners ask for, and catch access needs before day one, with every answer saved so the same questions can be asked again after training. The how-to covers timing, length, scoring and what to do with the answers; the FAQ covers wording, timing, anonymity, length and reuse.
tab_stories: Ravelstoke Freight sends an 8-question pre-test to 38 dispatchers a week before training on new dispatch software, 35 answer, 29 of 35 miss the question on rebooking a missed pickup, and the trainer moves that topic into the first hour.

Quillfirth Accounting asks 56 staff 5 spreadsheet questions before its training week, 52 answer, anyone with 4 or more right is emailed a seat in the advanced session, and the split is 21 advanced and 31 foundations.

Larchwell Grocers asks its 40 new store managers what they most want to handle better before a leadership workshop, 36 answer, 22 pick hard conversations with staff, and the trainer turns the afternoon into role-play on those conversations.

Tavistry Software asks 18 new hires about time zone, laptop setup and access needs before onboarding week, any access need emails the training coordinator, and 2 caption requests are booked before day one.
